name: Panel for Trade (panel.mq5)
summary: This is a semi-automated trading panel EA that provides a graphical interface on the chart for manual trade execution. It allows the user to adjust lot size and execute BUY, SELL, and CLOSE operations via on-chart buttons, with live bid/ask price display that updates on every tick.
summary_zh: 这是一个半自动交易面板EA，在图表上提供图形界面供手动执行交易。用户可通过面板按钮调整手数并执行买入、卖出和平仓操作，同时实时显示买卖价格并在每个tick更新。
strategy_analysis: 该EA本身不包含任何自动交易策略，它是一个基于图表事件驱动的半自动交易面板工具。入场条件完全由交易者手动决定，通过点击BUY或SELL按钮以当前ask/bid价格市价开仓，也可通过price BUY/price SELL按钮在显示当前价格的同时立即开仓。出场条件同样是手动触发，通过CLOSE按钮平掉当前品种的所有持仓。仓位管理方面，初始手数为0.01，用户可通过Plus/Minus按钮以0.01为步进增减手数，最低限制为0.01，但没有最大手数限制。资金管理完全缺失，没有止损、止盈设置，所有开仓操作的SL和TP参数均为0。该EA依赖MasterWindows框架ClassWin.mqh构建GUI界面，属于纯手动交易辅助工具而非策略型EA。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA does not contain any automated trading strategy; it is a chart event-driven semi-automated trading panel tool. Entry conditions are entirely decided by the trader manually, executing market orders at current ask/bid price via BUY or SELL buttons, or via price BUY/price SELL buttons that display current prices and immediately open positions. Exit conditions are also manually triggered through the CLOSE button which closes all positions for the current symbol. Position sizing starts at 0.01 lots, adjustable by Plus/Minus buttons in 0.01 increments with a minimum of 0.01, but there is no maximum lot size cap. Money management is completely absent—no stop loss or take profit is set, as all PositionOpen calls use 0 for both SL and TP parameters. The EA relies on the MasterWindows framework (ClassWin.mqh) to build its GUI interface, functioning purely as a manual trading assistance tool rather than a strategy-based EA.
pros: 提供直观的图表GUI界面，方便快速下单操作，无需通过MetaTrader标准交易对话框
实时更新买卖价格显示，交易者可随时掌握当前市场报价
手数可灵活调整，Plus/Minus按钮操作简便，有最小手数保护防止零手数下单
支持窗口最小化/隐藏功能，不占用过多图表空间
代码结构清晰，基于MasterWindows框架构建，事件驱动模型易于理解和扩展
pros_en: Provides an intuitive on-chart GUI for quick trade execution without using the standard MetaTrader trade dialog
Real-time bid/ask price display updates on every tick, keeping the trader informed of current market prices
Flexible lot sizing with convenient Plus/Minus buttons and minimum lot protection to prevent zero-lot orders
Supports window minimize/hide functionality, not occupying excessive chart space
Clean code structure built on the MasterWindows framework with an event-driven model that is easy to understand and extend
cons: 所有开仓操作均未设置止损和止盈（SL=0, TP=0），持仓风险完全不受控
没有最大手数限制，误操作可能导致下单过大手数造成严重亏损
CLOSE按钮使用PositionClose平掉整个品种持仓，无法选择性平仓部分手数
没有持仓检查和重复点击防护，快速多次点击BUY/SELL可能重复开仓
手数调整步长硬编码为0.01，不适应不同品种的最小手数和手数步长要求
cons_en: All position open operations have no stop loss or take profit (SL=0, TP=0), leaving position risk completely uncontrolled
No maximum lot size limit—accidental clicks could result in oversized orders causing significant losses
The CLOSE button uses PositionClose to close the entire symbol position, unable to partially close positions
No position check or duplicate click protection—rapid repeated clicks on BUY/SELL could open multiple duplicate positions
Lot adjustment step is hardcoded to 0.01, not adapting to different symbols' minimum lot and lot step requirements
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数，允许用户在面板上设置SL/TP值并在开仓时自动应用
增加最大手数限制和品种手数规范检查（使用SymbolInfoDouble获取SymbolInfoDouble_VOLUME_MIN/STEP/MAX），防止违规下单
添加持仓检查逻辑，在开仓前检查是否已有同方向持仓，并提供部分平仓功能而非仅全额平仓
improvements_en: Add stop loss and take profit parameters allowing users to set SL/TP values on the panel that are automatically applied when opening positions
Add maximum lot size limit and symbol lot specification validation (using SymbolInfoDouble for VOLUME_MIN/STEP/MAX) to prevent non-compliant orders
Add position checking logic before opening trades to detect existing same-direction positions, and provide partial close functionality instead of full close only

risk_points: 所有开仓均无止损止盈，持仓风险完全暴露，极端行情可能导致巨额亏损
无最大手数限制，误操作可导致过度杠杆
无重复点击防护，可能意外开多个仓位
CLOSE按钮一键全平可能误操作导致策略性持仓被意外关闭
risk_points_en: All positions are opened without stop loss or take profit, leaving risk fully exposed—extreme market moves could cause massive losses
No maximum lot size limit means accidental operation could lead to excessive leverage
No duplicate click protection could result in unintentionally opening multiple positions
The CLOSE button instantly closes all positions, which could accidentally close strategic holdings

summary_en: This is a semi-automated trading panel EA that provides a graphical interface on the chart for manual trade execution. It allows the user to adjust lot size and execute BUY, SELL, and CLOSE operations via on-chart buttons, with live bid/ask price display that updates on every tick.
